explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/86: does every subgraph of Q_n with ≥ (1/2 + o(1))n2^{n−1} edges contain a C₄, i.e. f(n) ≤ (1/2 + o(1))n2^{n−1}? The statement says: ∀ ε > 0, eventually in n, every H ≤ hypercube n (vertices Fin n → Bool, adjacency = Hamming distance 1) with ≥ (1/2+ε)n2^{n−1} edges contains cycleGraph 4 as a subgraph. That is the standard unpacking of the o(1). Faithful.
